orchestration.policy: STATEUI5 + PAYLOADREFRESH1. Russian operator terminology is normalized while machine contracts remain unchanged. DeviceState still distinguishes installed OpenWrt from RAM-root OpenWrt using actual mount topology. FUDAN1, OpenWrt production sysupgrade payloads, service/recovery assets and destructive writer backends remain unchanged from 0.2.50.
orchestration.usb: future after AN7581 USB host bring-up
orchestration.uart_fixes: UrsusBoot prompt recognition + clean live UART + auto native/RAM-bootstrap updater selection + bootdelay=9 RAM updater FIP; physical UART shell remains available in WebFailsafe
orchestration.installed_uart_upgrade: installed-UrsusBoot ordinary service targets FUDAN1; EXPERT BootROM emergency remains exact alpha3
orchestration.running_openwrt_detection: HTTP fingerprint -> root SSH; board/layout plus actual /,/rom,/overlay mount topology classify PERSISTENT_ROOT vs RAM_ROOT; unknown execution environment degrades DeviceState to PARTIAL
orchestration.emergency_confirmation: legacy destructive backend retained pending transaction refactor; no new confirmation ceremony added by 0.2.51 STATEUI5
orchestration.recovery_user_instruction: After a software reboot, wait for the router-wide LED reboot blink/restart cue, then immediately hold Reset through 2-short+3-long red flashes and steady red. If missed: power OFF, power ON, wait about 1 second, hold Reset 5-10 seconds until the same red sequence. Reset held before power-on is Airoha BootROM.
orchestration.bootrom_emergency_ursusboot: EXPERT BootROM uses exact alpha3 preloader + alpha3 RAM installer + alpha3 emergency FIP/BL2. This emergency lineage is separate from the FUDAN1 production target.
orchestration.console_palette: UrsusBoot WebFailsafe palette: amber #D99A4D / amber2 #C8873A / ink #F2E8DA / muted #A89179 / success #7CC493 / error #E8837A / UART-XMODEM-prompt sand #EFC079; no cyan/blue/magenta in main UI
orchestration.console_startup_mark: fixed-width 11-column ASCII bear; ASCII-only face, amber/sand UrsusBoot palette; printed once before language selection
orchestration.gate_policy: STOP only for wrong/corrupt source, wrong destructive target, missing required transport/writer, the single destructive confirmation, or failed post-write readback. SHA/CRC checks are automatic backend truth, not additional operator gates.
orchestration.one_key_payload_validation: lazy by detected state/transition; no startup all-payload/all-firmware gate

ursusboot.stock_commit: preserve ROM prefix + stock boot environment; full 512 KiB mtd0 readback
ursusboot.ubi_commit: HWFIX3 WebFailsafe UBI updater uses fit.new -> full readback -> fit.old -> fit -> final readback. ROOTFSMAX2 intentionally prioritizes OpenWrt rootfs_data capacity and leaves only 16 free PEBs; normal post-install OpenWrt updates are expected through OpenWrt sysupgrade/LuCI. The HWFIX3 staged recovery updater may reject large updates on this low-headroom layout.
ursusboot.bl2_policy: Routine self-update must not change BL2. BootROM recovery may restore exact alpha3 BL2 only after the live storage contract has been established; 0.2.29 showed the old universal fip-ID4 assumption is false on the tested migrated layout.
ursusboot.ram_installer_policy: exact alpha3 RAM installer; no alpha4/HF payload participates in emergency recovery
ursusboot.migration_rootfs_data: HWFIX3 migration proves the historical empty 1693-LEB rootfs_data. UrsusFlasher 0.2.43 ROOTFSMAX2 then, before first OpenWrt boot only, uses live ubi_free_pebs + ubi_leb_size, removes that empty volume, recreates ID6 to consume all allocatable PEBs except 16, verifies rootfs_data and exact 16-PEB headroom. UBI internal bad-block reserve is separate and untouched.
ursusboot.migration_volume_manifest: ubootenv,ubootenv2,bosa,ri,fip,fit,rootfs_data; BL2 commit only after manifest/rootfs_data/headroom/readback gates
ursusboot.lan_led_auto: LAN2-LAN4 enabled automatically in WebFailsafe after HW validation
ursusboot.reset_policy: ordinary Recovery UX: Reset asserted at UrsusBoot entry + stable ~750 ms debounce -> 2 short + 3 long red pattern -> steady red -> release; Reset before power-on is Airoha BootROM
ursusboot.uart_shell: physical UART line shell stays interactive while WebFailsafe event loop is active
ursusboot.web_fip_picker: accept .fip only; raw u-boot.bin/u-boot.lzma explicitly rejected
ursusboot.initramfs_fdt_alignment: unaligned embedded DTB copied to 8-byte aligned buffer before libfdt; strict compatible check retained

ursusboot.selfupdate_ubi_mtd: central classifier selects layout once; UBI path reuses classifier-attached canonical ubi; stock paths use raw bootblock transaction
ursusboot.ram_identity_gate: U-Boot 2026.07 base + native ursusupdate capability; LOCALVERSION is required by release QA but is not the sole runtime authorization gate
ursusboot.package_fix: 0.2.37 alpha4-HWFIX3-test1: removes the generic 3-second U-Boot autoboot countdown, keeps HELD_AT_BOOT 750 ms sticky Recovery, simplifies duplicate Recovery/System Info wording, links the UrsusBoot version to the project repository, and replaces the unsafe 16 MiB Expert staging window with the shared proven 0x90000000 / 64 MiB RAM staging used by firmware and initramfs/FIT. Test writes only existing active fip with one y/N confirmation.
ursusboot.emergency_recovery: BootROM recovery first performs read-only UBI/FIP/BL2 diagnostics. The legacy fixed-ID4 destructive transaction is disabled before any write when ID4 is occupied by a non-fip volume. Exact alpha3 payloads remain pinned; no new destructive storage contract is assumed.
ursusboot.emergency_boot_storage_policy: Root cause of the second post-rollback LZMA failure is CLOSED: BL2 CRC32 09fb6b36 was incompatible with exact alpha3 FIP; exact alpha3 BL2 9f7bf316 restored boot. BL2+FIP are a compatibility boundary.
ursusboot.persistent_hardware_status: HW PROVEN 2026-09-03: exact alpha3 BL2 CRC32 9f7bf316 + alpha4 LZMAFIX1 active fip CRC32 b1b313a5 cold-boots through BL31, U-Boot alpha4, UBI/FIT verification and Linux. Prior post-rollback LZMA res1/PANIC was caused by incompatible raw BL2 lineage, not by alpha4 BL33.
ursusboot.bootrom_emergency_ursusboot: EXPERT BootROM paths: read-only UBI/FIP/BL2 evidence; current BL2-only single-variable experiment; legacy fixed-ID4 recovery remains blocked on conflicting layouts. Exact alpha3 payloads remain pinned.
